englishCatalog.term.being.former.name: former human
englishCatalog.term.being.former.desc: Your fellow soldiers who went crazy because of the demonic influence. There's no hope for them anymore... only lead can heal their corrupted souls...
englishCatalog.term.being.sergeant.name: former sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.sergeant.desc: Same as former human soldiers, but meaner and tougher. They'll provide you with an extra hole if you're not careful. They always carry a shotgun, so be on your guard!
englishCatalog.term.being.sergeant.kill-desc: was shot by a former sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.sergeant.kill-desc-melee: was maimed by a former sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.captain.name: former captain
englishCatalog.term.being.captain.desc: Those were once really hardened marines, the tough fighting force of Earth. Now they're on the demonic side. They're really eager to make Swiss cheese out of you with their rapid fire chainguns...
englishCatalog.term.being.captain.kill-desc: was perforated by a former captain
englishCatalog.term.being.captain.kill-desc-melee: was maimed by a former captain
englishCatalog.term.being.commando.name: former commando
englishCatalog.term.being.commando.desc: These guys were evil to begin with. Being warped by Hell's power has only made them worse. Wielding a deadly plasma weapon, they should be treated with care... and lead.
englishCatalog.term.being.commando.kill-desc: was melted by former commando's plasma gun
englishCatalog.term.being.commando.kill-desc-melee: was killed by a former commando
englishCatalog.term.being.imp.name: imp
englishCatalog.term.being.imp.desc: Brown demonic servants from Hell, imps can throw fireballs at you. They're tough, mean and strong, and think only about sending you into oblivion...
englishCatalog.term.being.demon.name: demon
englishCatalog.term.being.demon.desc: You thought pink is cute? You won't anymore after meeting one of these bastards -- they are strong, tough and eager to rip your head off...
englishCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.name: lost soul
englishCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.desc: Quick flying fiery skull. These are the souls lost in Hell. Let them rest in peace, or rather, in pieces...
englishCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.kill-desc-melee: was spooked by a lost soul
englishCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.name: cacodemon
englishCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.desc: Big flying red horned heads. They spit huge explosive plasma balls. If you don't have the weapon to handle them, better run...
englishCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.kill-desc-melee: got too close to a cacodemon
englishCatalog.term.being.knight.name: hell knight
englishCatalog.term.being.knight.desc: These are Hell's warlords. They command hellish armies to battle. Not as tough as Barons but are still a pain in the ass...
englishCatalog.term.being.knight.kill-desc: was splayed by a hell knight
englishCatalog.term.being.knight.kill-desc-melee: was gutted by a hell knight
englishCatalog.term.being.baron.name: baron of hell
englishCatalog.term.being.baron.desc: Huge, almost humanoid, acid ball hurling monsters from your worst nightmares. They are the nobility of Hell.
englishCatalog.term.being.baron.kill-desc: was bruised by a baron of hell
englishCatalog.term.being.baron.kill-desc-melee: was ripped open by a baron of hell
englishCatalog.term.being.arachno.name: arachnotron
englishCatalog.term.being.arachno.desc: Evil can't get any purer. Spiderdemons equipped with a rapid-fire plasma cannon. Machine and flesh combined, kill on sight...
englishCatalog.term.being.pain.name: pain elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.pain.desc: Pain, pain, pain - this is the only thing these monsters live by, and the only thing they deliver. Wait, look again - they also deliver lost souls!
englishCatalog.term.being.revenant.name: revenant
englishCatalog.term.being.revenant.desc: Apparently when a demon dies, they pick him up, dust him off, wire him some combat gear, and send him back into battle. No rest for the wicked, eh? You wish your missiles did what his can do.
englishCatalog.term.being.mancubus.name: mancubus
englishCatalog.term.being.mancubus.desc: It's big, it's mean, and it has two rocket launchers. What can be worse?
englishCatalog.term.being.arch.name: arch-vile
englishCatalog.term.being.arch.desc: The worst thing you can encounter. With some unholy power far beyond your grasp they attack you with hellish flame, and can summon back the enemies you've worked so hard to banish!
englishCatalog.term.being.eformer.name: elite former human
englishCatalog.term.being.eformer.desc: These are the elite among the former humans. As stupid as their regular counterparts, but more resilient and packing quite a punch. Too bad their weapons are set to self-destruct on death.
englishCatalog.term.being.eformer.kill-desc: was killed by an elite former human
englishCatalog.term.being.eformer.kill-desc-melee: was killed by an elite former human
englishCatalog.term.being.esergeant.name: elite former sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.esergeant.desc: These are the elite among the former sergeants. And they carry firepower to boot! Too bad their weapons are set to self-destruct on death.
englishCatalog.term.being.esergeant.kill-desc: was shot by an elite sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.esergeant.kill-desc-melee: was maimed by an elite sergeant
englishCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.name: elite former captain
englishCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.desc: These are the elite among the former captains. Beware of the superior firepower! Too bad their weapons are set to self-destruct on death.
englishCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.kill-desc: was perforated by an elite captain
englishCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.kill-desc-melee: was maimed by an elite captain
englishCatalog.term.being.ecommando.name: elite former commando
englishCatalog.term.being.ecommando.desc: As expected, these ex-human soldiers are the best of the best! Armored, resilient and with superior firepower! Too bad their weapons are set to self-destruct on death.
englishCatalog.term.being.ecommando.kill-desc: was melted by an elite commando's gun
englishCatalog.term.being.ecommando.kill-desc-melee: was killed by an elite commando
englishCatalog.term.being.nimp.name: nightmare imp
englishCatalog.term.being.nimp.desc: Are you seeing things? What's with the color change? And why is it taking so much longer to kill these things!?
englishCatalog.term.being.nimp.kill-desc: was burned by a nightmare imp
englishCatalog.term.being.nimp.kill-desc-melee: was eviscerated by a nightmare imp
englishCatalog.term.being.ndemon.name: nightmare demon
englishCatalog.term.being.ndemon.desc: You liked it better when these guys were pink. Meet the stronger, tougher, more resilient way to meet your death.
englishCatalog.term.being.ndemon.kill-desc-melee: was eaten alive by a nightmare demon
englishCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.name: nightmare soul
englishCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.desc: The flying bluish skull. Wouldn't be a problem if there weren't so many of these nightmarish things...
englishCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.kill-desc-melee: was terrified by a nightmare soul
englishCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.name: nightmare cacodemon
englishCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.desc: Hell's latest improvement on demonic warfare - they're stronger, tougher, and angrier than ever.
englishCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.kill-desc: was fried by a nightmare cacodemon
englishCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.kill-desc-melee: was flattened by a nightmare cacodemon
englishCatalog.term.being.nknight.name: nightmare knight
englishCatalog.term.being.nknight.desc: The nightmare side of the knight and baron strain. You hope it won't get worse than this. You hope...
englishCatalog.term.being.nknight.kill-desc: was splayed by a nightmare knight
englishCatalog.term.being.nknight.kill-desc-melee: was gutted by a nightmare knight
englishCatalog.term.being.narachno.name: nightmare arachnotron
englishCatalog.term.being.narachno.desc: Pure nightmare spiders. You'd wish they weren't there...
englishCatalog.term.being.narachno.kill-desc: let an nightmare arachnotron get him
englishCatalog.term.being.npain.name: nightmare elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.npain.desc: Pain, pain, pain, nightmare pain. Oh and nightmare souls...
englishCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.name: nightmare revenant
englishCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.desc: This revenant has been dusted off and wired up one time too many. And it shows...
englishCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.kill-desc: couldn't evade a nightmare revenant's fireball
englishCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.kill-desc-melee: was mauled by a nightmare revenant
englishCatalog.term.being.nmancubus.name: nightmare mancubus
englishCatalog.term.being.nmancubus.desc: What's blue and has two rocket launchers? Something worse.
englishCatalog.term.being.nmancubus.kill-desc-melee: was flattened by a nightmare mancubus
englishCatalog.term.being.narch.name: nightmare arch-vile
englishCatalog.term.being.narch.desc: Oh God... *WHY* do they come in the nightmare variety too?
englishCatalog.term.being.bruiser.name: bruiser brother
englishCatalog.term.being.bruiser.desc: Tough as a dump truck and nearly as big, these Goliaths are the worst things on two legs since Tyrannosaurus Rex.
englishCatalog.term.being.bruiser.kill-desc: was baptised by a bruiser brother
englishCatalog.term.being.bruiser.kill-desc-melee: was pounded rather hard by a bruiser brother
englishCatalog.term.being.shambler.name: shambler
englishCatalog.term.being.shambler.desc: Even other monsters fear him, so expect a clobbering. He shrugs off explosions. Good luck.
englishCatalog.term.being.lava-elemental.name: lava elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.lava-elemental.kill-desc: was burned by a lava elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.lava-elemental.kill-desc-mele: was burned by a lava elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.agony.name: agony elemental
englishCatalog.term.being.agony.desc: Seems like the pain elementals' big momma!
englishCatalog.term.being.angel.name: Angel of Death
englishCatalog.term.being.angel.desc: Why doesn't a BFG work when you really need it? As if from a half-forgotten nightmare, you encounter the harbinger of death...
englishCatalog.term.being.angel.kill-desc-melee: was ripped apart by the Angel of Death
englishCatalog.term.medal.cyberdemon1.name: Cyberdemon's Head
englishCatalog.term.medal.cyberdemon1.desc: Killing the Cyberdemon w/o taking damage
englishCatalog.term.being.cyberdemon.name: Cyberdemon
englishCatalog.term.being.cyberdemon.desc: Monster and machine, combined. Equipped with a rocket launcher, this nightmare is the worst thing you can find in Hell. Or at least that is what you hope...
englishCatalog.term.being.cyberdemon.kill-desc-melee: was ripped apart by a Cyberdemon
englishCatalog.term.medal.mastermind1.name: Mastermind's Brain
englishCatalog.term.medal.mastermind1.desc: Killing the Mastermind w/o taking damage
englishCatalog.term.being.mastermind.name: Spider Mastermind
englishCatalog.term.being.mastermind.desc: You guess the Arachnotrons had to come from somewhere. Hi, mom. She doesn't have a plasma gun, so thank heaven for small favors. Instead, she has a super-chaingun.
englishCatalog.term.being.mastermind.kill-desc: let the Spider Mastermind pwn him
englishCatalog.term.being.jc.name: John Carmack
englishCatalog.term.being.jc.desc: You knew it. This is the true EVIL behind the invasion! This is the true mastermind of Hell! Kill him for he knows not the meaning of mercy! Kill him!! Kill him NOW!!!
englishCatalog.term.medal.dragonslayer2.name: Apostle Insignia
englishCatalog.term.being.apostle.name: Apostle
englishCatalog.term.being.apostle.desc: This seems so unreal, as though from another story...

englishCatalog.term.trait.reloader.name: Reloader
englishCatalog.term.trait.reloader.quote: "The humanity! My big gun is out of bullets! I can't believe it!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.reloader.desc: So you're out of ammo... no problem! You're especially gifted at keeping your gun well-fed - for every level of this trait, you can reload your gun 30% faster than the average marine!
englishCatalog.term.trait.eagle.name: Eagle Eye
englishCatalog.term.trait.eagle.quote: "One in the heart and one in the head, and don't you hesitate."
englishCatalog.term.trait.eagle.desc: You could knock a fly off the wall at 200 yards, but you prefer to hunt bigger, nastier prey. With each level of this trait, you'll increase your chance to hit by 2 points.
englishCatalog.term.trait.brute.name: Brute
englishCatalog.term.trait.brute.quote: "There's nothing wrong that I can't fix... with my hands!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.brute.desc: You don't need a gun - guns are for wusses! With each level of this trait you'll deal 3 more damage while bashing your enemies with your hands, knives, body parts, or whatever else is available. Also your melee accuracy increases by 2.
englishCatalog.term.trait.juggler.name: Juggler
englishCatalog.term.trait.juggler.quote: "Allow me to communicate to you my desire to have your guns."
englishCatalog.term.trait.juggler.desc: Your hands are so nimble you could work at a circus.  Unfortunately, the army got you first. The only benefit of your skill now is that you instantly swap prepared and inventory weapons, and automatically use a prepared melee weapon when need arises!
englishCatalog.term.trait.berserker.name: Berserker
englishCatalog.term.trait.berserker.quote: "Who's a man and a half? I'm a man and a half! Berserker packin' man and a half!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.berserker.desc: You hate this place, you hate these stupid monsters, and you HATE that this is all happening to you. In fact you hate it so much that there's a chance that you'll fly into a berserk rage when you repeatedly smack someone in melee, or get hit hard enough. (NOTE: You do NOT get the healing effect of a Berserk Pack.)
englishCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.name: Dualgunner
englishCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.quote: "The only thing I believe is I need another gun."
englishCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.desc: You're the kind of guy for whom one is never enough. When you and your buddies cruised bars Earthside, you always had a beer in each hand and when you left, you left with two girls. Where you're going now there aren't beer or girls, but there are guns! This trait lets you wield two pistols at once, firing them as fast as one.
englishCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.name: Dodgemaster
englishCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.quote: "Knock, knock. Who's there? Me, me, me, me, ME!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.desc: The battlefield is a dance for you! Each first sidestep after your move will automatically succeed.
englishCatalog.term.trait.intuition.name: Intuition
englishCatalog.term.trait.intuition.quote: "As I stride knee deep through the dead, all is clear. I know what must be done."
englishCatalog.term.trait.intuition.desc: Something's kept you alive all these years. Call it a sixth sense, call it a survival instinct, call it blind friggin' luck. All you know for sure is that where other men die, you live. The first level of this trait lets you evaluate levers and sense powerups, the second level lets you sense monsters.
englishCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.name: Whizkid
englishCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.quote: "Not big guns, but they are guns!  And I need guns!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.desc: You were always a brainy guy... Mom said you could have been an inventor but the Marine Corps picked you up first. Whether it's a toaster or a chaingun, there's always room for improvement! And with each level of this trait you can increase the number of mod slots on a weapon by 2 (by 1 for armor/boot). Also, at level 2+ you can slap (level-1) mods onto an assembly!
englishCatalog.term.trait.badass.name: Badass
englishCatalog.term.trait.badass.quote: "Who's the man? I'm the man! How bad? Real bad! I'm a 12.0 on a 10.0 scale of badness!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.badass.desc: You're the ultimate badass. Your blood runs so cold that it could make Hell freeze over (if they weren't too scared to take you). For each level, your maximum health before decay sets in is 50% higher, and you're knocked back one space less.
englishCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.name: Shottyman
englishCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.quote: "At this particular moment in time I don't believe I have a more deepfelt respect for any object than this shotgun..."
englishCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.desc: You and your shotgun have been through a lot together. You take care of him, and he "takes care" of any dumb bastard to get in your way. Through it all, you've learned that, in the middle of a firefight, if you stand still to reload, you die. So by taking this trait you gain the ability to reload shotguns on the move... ALL shotguns, and it surprisingly works for rocket launchers too!
englishCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.name: Triggerhappy
englishCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.quote: "Ooh, I like it! The sugar-sweet kiss of heavy ordinance!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.desc: "Shoot first and shoot fast" has always been your motto. And nobody shoots faster than you. With each rapid-fire weapon you get an extra rapid shot per level of this trait.
englishCatalog.term.trait.blademaster.name: Blademaster
englishCatalog.term.trait.blademaster.desc: You've mastered melee combat. Each time you finish off an opponent, you're immediately ready for another kill, and gain a free action!
englishCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.name: Vampyre
englishCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.quote: "I crave for blood on this kind of night..."
englishCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.desc: You hunger for blood! Each time you finish off an opponent with a melee attack, 10% of the target's max HP is added to your HP.
englishCatalog.term.trait.malicious.name: Malicious Blades
englishCatalog.term.trait.malicious.quote: "Don't need a gun! Guns are for wusses!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.malicious.desc: Knives, knives, knives! Not only do you do double damage with blades, but you can attack with a blade in each hand at the same time, and while carrying a blade in your off-hand, you parry 75% melee damage, and shield against 50% bullet, shrapnel and fire damage!
englishCatalog.term.trait.bulletdance.name: Bullet Dance
englishCatalog.term.trait.bulletdance.desc: Pistols are your game -- you can squeeze an additional shot from each of your pistols for each level of Triggerhappy at half the time cost!
englishCatalog.term.trait.gunkata.name: Gun Kata
englishCatalog.term.trait.gunkata.desc: You've mastered the martial art of pistol combat. After each successful dodge you can fire your pistols in 10% of normal time, or, if your last action was a move, in half of the time! Finally, each time you finish off a targeted opponent, you immediately reload your guns!
englishCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
englishCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.quote: "My cause is just... my will is strong..."
englishCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.desc: You always hit them where it counts! Each pistol shot you inflict deals maximum possible damage!
englishCatalog.term.trait.armydead.name: Army of the Dead
englishCatalog.term.trait.armydead.quote: "Might makes light! And I feel mighty!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.armydead.desc: You're the fucking army of justice. When you fire your trusty shotgun, no armor is a protection!
englishCatalog.term.trait.shottyhead.name: Shottyhead
englishCatalog.term.trait.shottyhead.desc: Shotgun is the gun on the move! While you can already reload on the move, this trait allows you to cut firetime to 1/3rd of the original!
englishCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.name: Fireangel
englishCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.quote: "Woo baby, I'm burnin' out of control!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.desc: You love heat, you're the angel of fire! Every missile you fire explodes, and those that already do explode with a +1 radius! Also, no explosion affects you, unless you take a direct hit.
englishCatalog.term.trait.ammochain.name: Ammochain
englishCatalog.term.trait.ammochain.desc: True gunners do not think of such unimportant things like ammo supply! As long as you use your trusty chain-fire weapons you only use up one ammo per volley!
englishCatalog.term.trait.cateye.name: Cateye
englishCatalog.term.trait.cateye.quote: "Huh? Whuzzat? Whuzzat? I like what I see!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.cateye.desc: Your eyes are so sharp they could cut through concrete. This trait lets you see your enemies from two spaces further away - and that means more time to shoot them!
englishCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.name: Entrenchment
englishCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.quote: "Hoy, hoy, I'm the boy... Packin' 80 pounds of heavenly joy!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.desc: Once the barrels get rollin' you become one hardcore fighting platform... when chainfiring a rapid weapon you get +50% to all resistances, and volleys after the first, take just one ammo!
englishCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.name: Survivalist
englishCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.quote: "You want a piece of me? C'mon, c'mon. Come at me with it!"
englishCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.desc: You're the mean motherfucker who gets through every predicament! Half the time you completely shrug off damage that would graze others and you heal over 100% using simple medpacks! Additionally small medpacks and globes are twice as effective!
englishCatalog.term.trait.runningman.name: Running Man
englishCatalog.term.trait.runningman.desc: You're the man on the run! Not only can you run twice as long, but you do not suffer any aiming penalties while doing so!
englishCatalog.term.trait.gunrunner.name: Gunrunner
englishCatalog.term.trait.gunrunner.desc: You're the man on the run! Not only can you run longer, but while running with a loaded non-rapid weapon in your hands, every move you automatically shoot the nearest enemy for free!
englishCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.name: Scavenger
englishCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.quote: "I do need a gun. I need a big gun. I need a really big gun..."
englishCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.desc: Whether it's a unique, exotic, assembled or modified item, you can always make use of it! Just Unload it once it's fully unloaded and you can scrap it for a useful mod pack (works on armors and boots too)!
englishCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.name: Phobos Arena
englishCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.entry: Then at last he found the Phobos Arena!
englishCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.welcome: You enter a big arena. There's blood everywhere. You hear heavy mechanical footsteps...

japaneseCatalog.term.being.former.name: 元人間
japaneseCatalog.term.being.former.desc: 悪魔の影響で正気を失った、かつての仲間たち。もはや救う望みはない……その腐った魂を癒やせるのは鉛の弾丸だけだ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.sergeant.name: 元軍曹
japaneseCatalog.term.being.sergeant.desc: 元人間の兵士と同じだが、もっと凶暴で頑丈だ。油断すれば体に穴を増やされる。必ずショットガンを携えているので警戒せよ！
japaneseCatalog.term.being.sergeant.kill-desc: 元軍曹に撃ち殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.sergeant.kill-desc-melee: 元軍曹に体を潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.captain.name: 元大尉
japaneseCatalog.term.being.captain.desc: かつては鍛え抜かれた海兵隊員で、地球の精鋭部隊を支えていた。今では悪魔の側に立ち、速射するチェーンガンで君を蜂の巣にする気満々だ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.captain.kill-desc: 元大尉に蜂の巣にされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.captain.kill-desc-melee: 元大尉に体を潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.commando.name: 元コマンドー
japaneseCatalog.term.being.commando.desc: こいつらは最初から邪悪だった。地獄の力に歪められて、さらに始末が悪くなった。殺傷力の高いプラズマ兵器を振るうので、慎重に対処せよ……鉛の弾丸で。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.commando.kill-desc: 元コマンドーのプラズマ銃に溶かされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.commando.kill-desc-melee: 元コマンドーに殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.imp.name: インプ
japaneseCatalog.term.being.imp.desc: 地獄に仕える茶色の悪魔。インプは火球を投げてくる。頑丈で凶暴、力も強く、君を消し去ることしか考えていない……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.imp.kill-desc: インプに焼き殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.imp.kill-desc-melee: インプに切り裂かれた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.demon.name: デーモン
japaneseCatalog.term.being.demon.desc: ピンク色はかわいいと思っていたか？　こいつに会えば、その考えは変わる。力強く頑丈で、君の首を引きちぎりたがっている……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.demon.kill-desc-melee: デーモンに噛み殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.name: ロストソウル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.desc: 炎をまとって素早く飛ぶ頭蓋骨。地獄で迷った魂だ。安らかに眠らせてやれ。いや、粉々にしてやれ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.lostsoul.kill-desc-melee: ロストソウルに取り殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.name: カコデーモン
japaneseCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.desc: 角の生えた巨大な赤い頭が空を飛ぶ。爆発する大きなプラズマ球を吐く。対抗できる武器がないなら、逃げたほうがいい……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.kill-desc: カコデーモンに打ち倒された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.cacodemon.kill-desc-melee: カコデーモンに近づきすぎた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.knight.name: ヘルナイト
japaneseCatalog.term.being.knight.desc: 地獄の軍を戦いへと率いる将軍。バロンほど頑丈ではないが、それでも厄介な相手だ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.knight.kill-desc: ヘルナイトに打ち倒された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.knight.kill-desc-melee: ヘルナイトに腹を裂かれた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.baron.name: バロン・オブ・ヘル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.baron.desc: 最悪の悪夢から現れた、巨大で人型に近い怪物。酸の球を投げつける、地獄の貴族だ。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.baron.kill-desc: バロン・オブ・ヘルに打ちのめされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.baron.kill-desc-melee: バロン・オブ・ヘルに引き裂かれた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arachno.name: アラクノトロン
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arachno.desc: これほど純粋な邪悪はない。速射プラズマ砲を備えた蜘蛛型の悪魔。機械と肉体が一つになっている。見つけ次第、倒せ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arachno.kill-desc: アラクノトロンの餌食になった
japaneseCatalog.term.being.pain.name: ペイン・エレメンタル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.pain.desc: 苦痛、苦痛、苦痛。それだけがこいつらの生きる理由で、相手にも苦痛しか与えない。待て、よく見ろ。ロストソウルまで送り出している！
japaneseCatalog.term.being.pain.name-plural: ペイン・エレメンタル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.revenant.name: レヴナント
japaneseCatalog.term.being.revenant.desc: 悪魔が死ぬと、拾ってほこりを払い、戦闘装備を取り付けて戦場へ戻すらしい。悪党に休みはないというわけか。君のミサイルにも、こいつのような芸当ができればいいのに。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.revenant.kill-desc: レヴナントの火球を避けられなかった
japaneseCatalog.term.being.revenant.kill-desc-melee: レヴナントに殴り殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.mancubus.name: マンキュバス
japaneseCatalog.term.being.mancubus.desc: 大きくて凶暴、そのうえロケットランチャーが二門。これ以上ひどい相手がいるだろうか？
japaneseCatalog.term.being.mancubus.kill-desc: マンキュバスのロケットに吹き飛ばされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.mancubus.kill-desc-melee: マンキュバスに押し潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arch.name: アーチヴァイル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arch.desc: 遭遇しうる最悪の敵。理解を超えた不浄な力で地獄の炎を浴びせ、苦労して倒した敵を呼び戻してしまう！
japaneseCatalog.term.being.arch.kill-desc: アーチヴァイルに焼き尽くされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.eformer.name: 精鋭の元人間
japaneseCatalog.term.being.eformer.desc: 元人間たちの精鋭。普通の連中と同じくらい愚かだが、もっと頑丈で攻撃も強烈だ。残念ながら、武器は持ち主が死ぬと自壊するように設定されている。

japaneseCatalog.term.being.esergeant.name: 精鋭の元軍曹
japaneseCatalog.term.being.esergeant.desc: 元軍曹たちの精鋭。火力もたっぷり備えている！　残念ながら、武器は持ち主が死ぬと自壊するように設定されている。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.esergeant.kill-desc: 精鋭の元軍曹に撃ち殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.esergeant.kill-desc-melee: 精鋭の元軍曹に体を潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.name: 精鋭の元大尉
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.desc: 元大尉たちの精鋭。強力な火力に注意せよ！　残念ながら、武器は持ち主が死ぬと自壊するように設定されている。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.kill-desc: 精鋭の元大尉に蜂の巣にされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecaptain.kill-desc-melee: 精鋭の元大尉に体を潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecommando.name: 精鋭の元コマンドー
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecommando.desc: 予想どおり、この元人間の兵士たちは精鋭中の精鋭だ！　装甲をまとい、頑丈で、火力も優れている！　残念ながら、武器は持ち主が死ぬと自壊するように設定されている。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecommando.kill-desc: 精鋭の元コマンドーの銃に溶かされた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ecommando.kill-desc-melee: 精鋭の元コマンドーに殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nimp.name: 悪夢のインプ
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nimp.desc: 見間違いか？　なぜ色が違う？　しかも、なぜ倒すのにこんなに時間がかかるんだ！？
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nimp.kill-desc: ナイトメア・インプに焼き殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nimp.kill-desc-melee: ナイトメア・インプに腹をえぐられた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ndemon.name: 悪夢のデーモン
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ndemon.desc: ピンク色だったころのほうが、まだましだった。さらに強く、頑丈で、しぶとくなった死神のお出ましだ。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ndemon.kill-desc-melee: ナイトメア・デーモンに生きたまま食われた
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.name: 悪夢のソウル
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.desc: 青みがかった空飛ぶ頭蓋骨。こんな悪夢じみた奴が大群でなければ、大した問題ではないのだが……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nlostsoul.kill-desc-melee: ナイトメア・ソウルに取り殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.name: 悪夢のカコデーモン
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.desc: 地獄が悪魔の戦術に加えた最新の改良。これまで以上に強く、頑丈で、怒りに満ちている。
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.kill-desc: ナイトメア・カコデーモンに焼き殺された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.ncacodemon.kill-desc-melee: ナイトメア・カコデーモンに潰された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nknight.name: 悪夢のヘルナイト

japaneseCatalog.term.being.nknight.kill-desc: ナイトメア・ヘルナイトに打ち倒された
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nknight.kill-desc-melee: ナイトメア・ヘルナイトに腹を裂かれた

japaneseCatalog.term.being.narachno.kill-desc: ナイトメア・アラクノトロンの餌食になった
japaneseCatalog.term.being.narachno.name-plural: 悪夢のアラクノトロン

japaneseCatalog.term.being.npain.desc: 苦痛、苦痛、苦痛、悪夢の苦痛。それに悪夢のソウルまで……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.name: 悪夢のレヴナント
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.desc: このレヴナントは、ほこりを払われて装備を取り付けられる回数が一度多すぎた。その結果は一目瞭然だ……
japaneseCatalog.term.being.nrevenant.kill-desc: ナイトメア・レヴナントの火球を避けられなかった

japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ironman.name: 鉄人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ironman.quote: 「肋骨が二、三本折れただけだ。なんでもない。俺を止めたけりゃ……頭を砕くか、心臓をえぐり出すんだな」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ironman.desc: 君は筋金入りの不死身だ。骨がすべて折れ、血が残らなくなるまで戦い続ける。この特性のレベルごとに、初期 HP の 20% 分、体力が増える。さらに、弾丸・散弾・近接攻撃への耐性がレベルごとに 10% 上がる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.finesse.name: 技巧
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.finesse.desc: 引き金を引きたくて指がうずく、と聞いたことがあるか？　君の指は水ぼうそう以上にうずく。この特性のレベルごとに、射撃と攻撃を 10% 速く行える。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.hellrunner.name: 地獄の走者
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.hellrunner.quote: 「おお、来たぞ！ 夜行列車のお出ましだ！ シュッシュッ、ブギーだ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.hellrunner.desc: 君は脚の生えた列車だ。この特性のレベルごとに移動が 15% 速くなり、飛んでくる厄介な弾をかわす確率も 10% 上がる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.nails.name: 鉄の体
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.nails.quote: 「地獄の恐怖さえ、お前を殺せなかった！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.nails.desc: 聞こえる音は弾が壁に跳ね返る音ではない。君に跳ね返っている音だ！　この特性のレベルごとに受けるダメージをさらに 1 点減らし、炎・酸・プラズマへの耐性が 10% 上がる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bitch.name: 容赦なき攻撃
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bitch.quote: 「全員殺せ。あとは神がより分ける」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bitch.desc: 君は分隊で最も凶暴で頑丈な野郎だ。痛みを好み、他人に与えるのはもっと好む。悪魔すら君の名を知る。この特性のレベルごとに、普通の海兵隊員より 1 点多くダメージを与えるからだ。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gun.name: 銃の申し子
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gun.quote: 「この腕前、この暴力の力を見てみろ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gun.desc: 君はピストルを愛し、毎日手入れをして最高の状態に保つ。扱いを熟知しているため、この特性のレベルごとにピストルを 10% 速く撃ち、ダメージを 3 点多く与えられる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.reloader.name: 装填手
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.reloader.quote: 「なんてこった！ 俺の大砲が弾切れだ！ 信じられねえ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.reloader.desc: 弾切れか……問題ない！　君は銃に弾を食わせるのが特に得意だ。この特性のレベルごとに、普通の海兵隊員より 30% 速く装填できる！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.eagle.name: 鷹の目
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.eagle.quote: 「心臓に一発、頭に一発。ためらうな」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.eagle.desc: 200 ヤード先の壁のハエも撃ち落とせるが、君が好むのはもっと大きく邪悪な獲物。この特性のレベルごとに、命中補正が 2 点上がる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.brute.name: 怪力
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.brute.quote: 「どんな厄介事だって片づけてやる……この手でな！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.brute.desc: 銃などいらない。銃は弱虫のものだ！　手、ナイフ、体の一部、手に入る何でも使って敵を殴り、この特性のレベルごとにダメージを 3 点多く与える。近接命中補正も 2 点上がる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.juggler.name: ジャグラー
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.juggler.quote: 「君の銃が欲しいという私の願いを、お伝えしておこう」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.juggler.desc: 君の手はサーカスで働けるほど器用だ。残念ながら軍隊に先を越された。今その技で得られる恩恵は、予備武器と所持武器を瞬時に持ち替え、必要なときには予備の近接武器を自動的に使えることだ！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.berserker.name: バーサーカー
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.berserker.quote: 「一人半の男ってのは誰だ？ 俺が一人半の男だ！ バーサーカーを抱えた、一人半の男だ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.berserker.desc: この場所も、ばかな怪物たちも、こんな目に遭うことも大嫌いだ。その憎しみゆえ、近接攻撃を繰り返すか十分に強い打撃を受けると、狂戦士の怒りに入ることがある。（注意：バーサーク・パックの回復効果は得られない。）
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.name: 二丁拳銃
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.quote: 「確かなのは、もう一丁銃が必要だってことだけだ」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dualgunner.desc: 君は一つでは決して満足しない男だ。地球のバーでは両手にビールを持ち、帰りは女の子を二人連れていた。これから向かう場所にビールも女の子もいないが、銃はある！　二丁のピストルを、一丁と同じ速さで同時に撃てる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.name: 回避の達人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.quote: 「トントン。誰だ？ 俺だ、俺だ、俺だ、俺だ、俺だ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.dodgemaster.desc: 君にとって戦場はダンスの舞台！　移動のあと、最初の横かわしは必ず成功する。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.intuition.name: 直感
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.intuition.quote: 「死体に膝まで埋まりながら進むと、すべてがはっきりする。何をすべきか、わかっている」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.intuition.desc: 第六感、生存本能、あるいはただの幸運。その何かが君を何年も生かしてきた。他人が死ぬ場所で、君は生き残る。この特性のレベル 1 でレバーを見極め、パワーアップを感知できる。レベル 2 では怪物を感知できる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.name: 神童
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.quote: 「大砲じゃないが、銃には違いない！ それに俺には銃が必要なんだ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.whizkid.desc: 君は昔から頭がよかった。母は発明家になれると言ったが、海兵隊に先を越された。トースターでもチェーンガンでも、改良の余地はある！　この特性のレベルごとに、武器の MOD スロットを 2、防具やブーツでは 1 増やせる。さらにレベル 2 以上では、組立武器や防具にも（レベル − 1）個の MOD を追加できる！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.badass.name: 不屈
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.badass.quote: 「誰が最強だ？ 俺が最強だ！ どれだけ強いって？ とんでもなく強い！ 強さを十点満点で測るなら、俺は十二点だ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.badass.desc: 君は究極の不屈の男。血は地獄を凍らせるほど冷たい。レベルごとに、体力が減衰し始める上限が 50% 分上がり、ノックバックされる距離が 1 マス減る。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.name: ショットガンの達人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.quote: 「今この瞬間、このショットガンほど心から敬意を抱く物は、ほかにないと思う……」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.shottyman.desc: 君とショットガンは苦楽を共にしてきた。君が銃の面倒を見て、銃は邪魔者の「面倒を見る」。撃ち合いの最中に装填のため立ち止まれば死ぬ、と学んだ君は、移動しながら装填できる。すべてのショットガンで使え、驚くことにロケットランチャーでも使える！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.name: 乱射魔
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.quote: 「おお、気に入った！ 重火器の、とろけるように甘いキスだ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.triggerhappy.desc: 「先に、速く撃て」が君の信条。そして君より速く撃つ者はいない。この特性のレベルごとに、連射武器の射撃数が 1 増える。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.blademaster.name: 剣の達人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.blademaster.quote: 「ああ！ チェーンソーだ！ こいつに話をつけてもらおう！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.blademaster.desc: 近接戦を極めた君は、相手にとどめを刺すたび、すぐ次の敵を倒す用意ができる。行動を一回、無料で得る！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.name: 吸血鬼
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.quote: 「こんな夜は、血が欲しくなる……」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.vampyre.desc: 君は血に飢えている！　近接攻撃で相手にとどめを刺すたび、相手の最大 HP の 10% が君の HP に加わる。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.malicious.name: 邪悪な刃
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.malicious.quote: 「銃なんかいらねえ！ 銃は腰抜けの使うもんだ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.malicious.desc: ナイフ、ナイフ、ナイフ！　刃物のダメージが二倍になり、両手に刃物を持って同時に攻撃できる。副手に刃物を持つ間は、近接ダメージを 75% 受け流し、弾丸・散弾・炎のダメージを 50% 防ぐ！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bulletdance.name: 弾丸の舞
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bulletdance.quote: 「正義――そして圧倒的な火力――が勝利した！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.bulletdance.desc: ピストルこそ君の得意分野。連射魔のレベルごとに、各ピストルから追加の一発を、半分の時間で撃てる！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gunkata.name: ガン＝カタ
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gunkata.quote: 「何事もなく、とはいかなかった」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gunkata.desc: ピストルを使う武術を極めた君は、回避に成功した直後、通常の 10% の時間でピストルを撃てる。直前の行動が移動なら、半分の時間で撃てる。さらに、狙った相手を倒すたび、銃を即座に装填する！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.name: 狙撃の達人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.quote: 「我が大義は正しい……我が意志は強い……」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.sharpshooter.desc: 必ず急所を撃ち抜く！　ピストルの一発一発が、可能な最大ダメージを与える！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.armydead.name: 死者の軍団
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.armydead.quote: 「力があれば光も生まれる！ そして俺には力がみなぎっている！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.armydead.desc: 君は正義の軍隊そのものだ。頼れるショットガンを撃てば、どんな防具も役に立たない！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.shottyhead.name: ショットガン狂
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.shottyhead.desc: ショットガンは動きながら使う銃だ！　移動中の装填に加え、この特性で射撃時間が元の 3 分の 1 になる！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.name: 炎の天使
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.quote: 「ウー、ベイビー、俺の炎はもう止まらねえ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.fireangel.desc: 熱を愛する君は炎の天使！　撃った弾がすべて爆発し、元から爆発する弾は半径が 1 増える。さらに、直撃を受けない限り、爆発の影響を受けない。
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ammochain.name: 無限弾帯
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ammochain.quote: 「おい、チェーンガン！ 遠慮なんか知るか！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.ammochain.desc: 真の射手は、弾薬供給などという些細なことを考えない！　頼れる連続射撃武器を使う限り、一斉射撃ごとに消費する弾薬はたった 1 発！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.cateye.name: 猫の目
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.cateye.quote: 「ん？ なんだありゃ？ なんだありゃ？ 気に入ったぜ！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.cateye.desc: 君の目はコンクリートを切り裂くほど鋭い。この特性で 2 マス遠くの敵まで見え、撃つ時間もそれだけ増える！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.name: 陣地防御
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.quote: 「ホイ、ホイ、俺の出番だ……天にも昇る八十ポンドの喜びを抱えてな！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.entrenchment.desc: 銃身が回り始めれば、君は強力な射撃陣地だ。連射武器で連続射撃中は、すべての耐性が 50% 上がり、二回目以降の一斉射撃では弾薬を 1 発しか消費しない！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.name: 生存の達人
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.quote: 「俺とやり合いたいのか？ 来いよ、来いよ。かかってこい！」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.survivalist.desc: どんな窮地も生き抜く、しぶとい野郎だ！　ほかの者ならかすり傷を受ける攻撃も半分の確率で無傷となり、普通の医療パックで体力を 100% 超まで回復できる。さらに、小型医療パックとオーブの効果が二倍になる！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.runningman.name: 走り続ける者
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.runningman.desc: 君は走り続ける男！　走れる時間が二倍になり、走行中の命中ペナルティも受けない！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gunrunner.name: 駆ける射手
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.gunrunner.desc: 君は走り撃ちの男！　走れる時間が長くなり、装填された非連射武器を手に走る間は、移動のたびに最も近い敵へ自動で無料の一発を撃つ！
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.name: 回収屋
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.quote: 「銃が必要だ。大きな銃が必要だ。とびきり大きな銃が必要なんだ……」
japaneseCatalog.term.trait.scavenger.desc: ユニーク品、特殊品、組立品、改造品。どれも役立てられる！　弾をすべて抜いたあと、もう一度「弾を抜く」を選べば分解し、便利な MOD パックを得られる。防具やブーツにも使える！
japaneseCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.name: フォボスの闘技場
japaneseCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.entry: そしてついに、フォボスの闘技場を見つけた！
japaneseCatalog.term.level.phobos-arena.welcome: 大きな闘技場へ入った。至るところ血まみれだ。重い機械の足音が聞こえる……
